name: Business
overview: Scripture teaches that business is to be conducted with integrity, diligence, and dependence on God. Honest dealings, such as fair wages and just measures, are commanded as pleasing to the Lord, while dishonesty is condemned (Leviticus 19:13; Proverbs 11:1). Wealth and success come through the power God provides and the faithful commitment of one’s work to Him (Deuteronomy 8:18; Proverbs 16:3), and all actions in business should be done in the name of Jesus with gratitude to God (Colossians 3:17). Diligence and careful management are also emphasized as keys to prosperity (Proverbs 10:4).
